title: Industrial radiography training, certification and supervision practice questions
description: Practice questions on radiographer and assistant training, certification, RSO duties, two qualified individuals, supervision and training records (10 CFR 34).

questions.question: During a trainee's evaluation, the examiner watches the trainee apply the safety rules and principles of industrial radiography while using all appropriate equipment and procedures. Which term defined in 34.3 matches this demonstration?

options.A: Hands-on experience
options.B: Practical Examination
options.C: Annual refresher safety training
options.D: Radiographer certification

questions.explanation: 34.3 defines a Practical Examination as "a demonstration through practical application of the safety rules and principles in industrial radiography including use of all appropriate equipment and procedures."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.3, Definitions (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under the 34.3 definition, who conducts or provides annual refresher safety training?

options.A: A certifying entity, for each radiographer it has certified
options.B: The NRC, through its regional offices
options.C: The Agreement State where the work is performed
options.D: The licensee, for its employees

questions.explanation: Annual refresher safety training means "a review conducted or provided by the licensee for its employees on radiation safety aspects of industrial radiography."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.3, Definitions (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under the 34.3 definition, to whom is a radiographer responsible for assuring compliance with the requirements of the Commission's regulations and the conditions of the license?

options.A: The licensee
options.B: The certifying entity that certified the radiographer
options.C: The client who owns the jobsite
options.D: The radiographer's assistant

questions.explanation: 34.3 defines a radiographer as an individual who performs or personally supervises industrial radiographic operations "and who is responsible to the licensee for assuring compliance with the requirements of the Commission's regulations and the conditions of the license."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.3, Definitions (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A radiographer is working at a refinery jobsite, away from any permanent radiographic installation, with a second qualified individual. What does 34.41(a) say this additional qualified individual shall do?

options.A: Operate the control drive mechanism while the radiographer performs surveys
options.B: Stay at the field station to answer emergency calls
options.C: Observe the operations and be capable of providing immediate assistance to prevent unauthorized entry
options.D: Fill in the utilization log for each exposure

questions.explanation: 34.41(a): "The additional qualified individual shall observe the operations and be capable of providing immediate assistance to prevent unauthorized entry."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.41, Conducting industrial radiographic operations (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 34.41(b), where must radiographic operations conducted at locations of use authorized on the license be conducted, unless specifically authorized by the Commission?

options.A: Inside a locked storage area at the field station
options.B: At any site where two qualified individuals are present
options.C: In a permanent radiographic installation
options.D: Inside a vehicle that has been surveyed by the RSO

questions.explanation: 34.41(b): operations at locations of use authorized on the license "must be conducted in a permanent radiographic installation, unless specifically authorized by the Commission."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.41, Conducting industrial radiographic operations (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: An RSO candidate has completed the training and testing requirements of 34.43(a) and has the required hands-on experience as a qualified radiographer. Which further item is part of the minimum qualifications listed in 34.42(a)?

options.A: Formal training in the establishment and maintenance of a radiation protection program
options.B: A university degree in health physics
options.C: A radiographer trainer license issued by the NRC
options.D: Five years of service as a radiographer's assistant

questions.explanation: 34.42(a)(3) lists "Formal training in the establishment and maintenance of a radiation protection program."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.42, Radiation Safety Officer for industrial radiography (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: An RSO finds that operations at a jobsite are not being conducted safely. Which authority is included in the RSO's duties under 34.42(c)(5)?

options.A: To revoke the radiographer's certification
options.B: To grant the licensee an exemption from Part 34
options.C: To amend the license conditions on the spot
options.D: To assume control for instituting corrective actions including stopping of operations when necessary

questions.explanation: 34.42(c)(5) includes "Ensuring that operations are conducted safely and to assume control for instituting corrective actions including stopping of operations when necessary."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.42, Radiation Safety Officer for industrial radiography (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: What duty does 34.42(c)(2) give the RSO for the training program for radiographic personnel?

options.A: Issuing radiographer certification to those who complete it
options.B: Overseeing and approving all phases of the training program
options.C: Submitting each written test to a certifying entity for grading
options.D: Teaching every class in person

questions.explanation: The RSO's duties include "Overseeing and approving all phases of the training program for radiographic personnel, ensuring that appropriate and effective radiation protection practices are taught."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.42, Radiation Safety Officer for industrial radiography (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A certified radiographer joins a new licensee. Under 34.43(b)(1), which licensee-specific documents must the radiographer have received copies of and instruction in before acting as a radiographer for that licensee?

options.A: The licensee's insurance policy and employee handbook
options.B: The customer's site safety plan for each jobsite
options.C: The NRC license(s) under which the radiographer will perform industrial radiography, and the licensee's operating and emergency procedures
options.D: The device manufacturer's sales catalog and warranty terms

questions.explanation: 34.43(b)(1) requires copies of and instruction in, among other items, "the NRC license(s) under which the radiographer will perform industrial radiography, and the licensee's operating and emergency procedures".

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.43, Training (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 34.43(b)(2), how must an individual demonstrate understanding of the licensee's license and operating and emergency procedures before acting as a radiographer?

options.A: By successful completion of a written or oral examination covering this material
options.B: By signing a statement that the procedures have been read
options.C: By working 2000 hours under a qualified radiographer
options.D: By passing a test given by the NRC regional office

questions.explanation: 34.43(b)(2) requires that the individual "Has demonstrated understanding of the licensee's license and operating and emergency procedures by successful completion of a written or oral examination covering this material."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.43, Training (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A certified radiographer starts work for a new licensee. Besides training in the use of the licensee's radiographic exposure devices and sealed sources, what training does 34.43(b)(3) require before the individual acts as a radiographer?

options.A: Training in bidding and pricing radiography jobs
options.B: Training in interpreting radiographs for weld acceptance
options.C: Training in opening and repairing sealed sources
options.D: Training in the daily inspection of devices and associated equipment, and in the use of radiation survey instruments

questions.explanation: 34.43(b)(3) requires that the individual "Has received training in the use of the licensee's radiographic exposure devices, sealed sources, in the daily inspection of devices and associated equipment, and in the use of radiation survey instruments."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.43, Training (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Which of these is one of the subjects that 34.43(g) says the licensee shall include in radiographer training?

options.A: Interpretation of weld defects on radiographs
options.B: Case histories of accidents in radiography
options.C: Darkroom film processing chemistry
options.D: Pricing and bidding radiography jobs

questions.explanation: 34.43(g)(5) lists "Case histories of accidents in radiography."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.43, Training (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 34.43(c)(3), how must an individual demonstrate understanding of the instructions provided under (c)(1) before acting as a radiographer's assistant?

options.A: By successfully completing a written test on the subjects covered
options.B: By being certified by a certifying entity
options.C: By completing a minimum of 2 months of on-the-job training
options.D: By an oral briefing from the client at the jobsite

questions.explanation: 34.43(c)(3) requires that the individual "Has demonstrated understanding of the instructions provided under (c)(1) of this section by successfully completing a written test on the subjects covered."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.43, Training (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Refresher training and job performance inspections
questions.question: A radiographer's assistant has not participated in an industrial radiographic operation for more than 6 months since the last inspection. What does 34.43(e)(2) require before the assistant can next participate in a radiographic operation?

options.A: Obtaining radiographer certification from a certifying entity
options.B: Repeating the written test of 34.43(c)(3)
options.C: Repeating 2 months of on-the-job training
options.D: Re-demonstrating knowledge of the training requirements of 34.43(c)(2) by a practical examination

questions.explanation: 34.43(e)(2): "the radiographer's assistant must re-demonstrate knowledge of the training requirements of § 34.43(c)(2) by a practical examination before these individuals can next participate in a radiographic operation."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.43, Training (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Refresher training and job performance inspections
questions.question: What does 34.43(e)(4) say about operations where a single individual serves as both radiographer and RSO and performs all radiography operations?

options.A: The inspection program must be conducted by a certifying entity
options.B: The individual must be observed by the NRC every 6 months
options.C: An inspection program is not required
options.D: A second RSO must be named as designee

questions.explanation: 34.43(e)(4): "In those operations where a single individual serves as both radiographer and RSO, and performs all radiography operations, an inspection program is not required."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.43, Training (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Besides using radiographic exposure devices, associated equipment or sealed sources, which activity does 34.46 say a radiographer's assistant may perform only under the personal supervision of a radiographer?

options.A: Only surveys made at permanent radiographic installations
options.B: The radiation surveys required by 34.49(b) to determine that the sealed source has returned to the shielded position after an exposure
options.C: Only surveys made during the assistant's first 2 months of work
options.D: Only surveys made with an instrument that is not calibrated

questions.explanation: Under 34.46, whenever a radiographer's assistant "conducts radiation surveys required by § 34.49(b) to determine that the sealed source has returned to the shielded position after an exposure, the assistant shall be under the personal supervision of a radiographer."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.46, Supervision of radiographers' assistants (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A radiographer plans to supervise an assistant by phone from the field station while the assistant uses the exposure device at a jobsite. Under 34.46(a), what must personal supervision include?

options.A: The radiographer's physical presence at the site where the sealed sources are being used
options.B: The radiographer's review of the assistant's utilization log at the end of the day
options.C: The radiographer's written approval of each exposure before it is made
options.D: The radiographer's signature on the assistant's dosimetry record

questions.explanation: 34.46: "The personal supervision must include: (a) The radiographer's physical presence at the site where the sealed sources are being used."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.46, Supervision of radiographers' assistants (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 34.79(b), what must the records of annual refresher safety training list?

options.A: Only the total number of training hours given that year
options.B: The score each attendee earned on a written test
options.C: The topics discussed, the dates the training was conducted, and names of the instructors and attendees
options.D: The certifying entity's approval of the training content

questions.explanation: 34.79(b): "The records must list the topics discussed during the refresher safety training, the dates the annual refresher safety training was conducted, and names of the instructors and attendees."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.79, Records of training and certification (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 34.79(b), what must the records of inspections of job performance also include?

options.A: A copy of the inspector's own radiographer certification
options.B: The client's signature for each job observed
options.C: Photographs of each exposure setup
options.D: A list showing the items checked and any non-compliances observed by the RSO

questions.explanation: 34.79(b): "For inspections of job performance, the records must also include a list showing the items checked and any non-compliances observed by the RSO."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.79, Records of training and certification (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Which item does 34.79(a) say the record of training of each radiographer and radiographer's assistant must include?

options.A: The individual's home address
options.B: Copies of written tests
options.C: The individual's school transcripts
options.D: Letters of reference from prior employers

questions.explanation: 34.79(a): "The record must include radiographer certification documents and verification of certification status, copies of written tests, dates of oral and practical examinations, and names of individuals conducting and receiving the oral and practical examinations."

source.title: eCFR: 10 CFR 34.79, Records of training and certification (as of Nov 4, 2026)
